subject: Crescent Labs renewal — private footprint expansion & term commitment
messages:
From: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@crescentlabs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Matthew Lane <matthew.lane@crescentlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: Private footprint expansion & term ask

Hi Marcus,

Quick note as we head into our renewal window (May 1 contract anniversary): Crescent Labs is planning to expand our private footprint to support a new analytics pipeline and a separate staging/canary environment. High-level asks:

- Add one isolated analytics cluster in us-west-2 (dedicated to PHI analytics workloads, isolation required)
- Provision a small staging VPC (canary traffic, replicates prod traffic shape) that can burst to the dedicated pool during deploy windows
- Commit to a 24-month term on the expanded baseline to get predictable pricing

We have a budget window for Q3 and would like to lock commercial terms early. Can you share a scoped proposal and target pricing? Also flag any security/compliance blockers — our InfoSec will need the SOC2 artifacts and a short runbook for the isolated cluster.

Attaching a short doc with our internal sizing assumptions (Crescent_Renewal_Request_v1.pdf).

Thanks — Emma
Emma Zhao
Head of ML Platform | Crescent Labs
emma.zhao@crescentlabs.com
+1 415-555-0199

Attachment: Crescent_Renewal_Request_v1.pdf (1 page, request summary)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@crescentlabs.com>, Matthew Lane <matthew.lane@crescentlabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: Private footprint expansion & term ask

Emma — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Kimberly (AE) for commercial, Priyom (Solutions) for scope/ops, and Monica (CS) for runbook/transition notes.

Quick proposal summary from our side (draft):
- Baseline: renew existing private footprint at current committed capacity (no change)
- Add: 1x isolated analytics cluster (8x A100-equivalent GPUs, dedicated network, separate tenant)
- Add: Staging VPC (2x burst-capacity nodes pinned to the dedicated pool for controlled deploys)
- Canary: optional canary window (2 GPUs) configured to autoscale from staging to baseline during deploys
- Term: 24-month committed term on the expanded baseline (suggested discount: 10% vs month-to-month after expansion)
- SLA/Support: standard Dedicated SLAs + quarterly operational review & runbook handover

Ops notes / blockers we’ll need to confirm:
- Security: SOC2 artifacts (we can supply), encryption in transit and at rest by default, KMS integration required for the isolated cluster
- Networking: we’ll need your VPC peering details and a CIDR carve-out for the staging VPC; Egress considerations for analytics export jobs
- Lead times: provisioning isolated analytics cluster ~= 4–6 weeks after PO + security sign-off; staging VPC can be staged in 1–2 weeks as a soft environment if we reserve burst capacity

I’ve attached a short scope workbook (RI_proposed_scope_20270412.xlsx) with pricing bands and timeline estimates. Next steps: Kimberly to propose a term amendment and formal quote; Crescent to confirm PO timeline and security questionnaire contact.

If that plan looks reasonable I’ll schedule a short call this week to walk the timeline.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RI_proposed_scope_20270412.xlsx (price bands / scope)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@crescentlabs.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: Private footprint expansion & term ask

Emma — thanks for the request and Marcus / team for the draft scope.

Commercial ask / proposal:
- 24-month amendment covering the expanded baseline (analytics cluster + staging VPC + canary): $460,000 USD committed annual run-rate (reflects 10% term discount).
- One-time provisioning/setup fee: $12,500 (security onboarding, KMS setup, runbook creation).
- Add-on option: standby hot-swap cluster (for DR) priced at $85,000/year if you want an immediate warm standby.

What we need from Crescent to proceed:
1) Confirmation of the CIDR and VPC contact for peering (security pre-check)
2) Signed amendment / DocuSign (I’ve drafted an amendment and will send via DocuSign once you confirm commercials) — link will be provided in the next email.
3) PO or purchase timing — legal typically needs 5–7 business days; do you have a target PO date?

Security items — Monica will follow up directly on the SOC2 package and provide the short runbook template. Priyom: recommend we prepare a short checklist for the isolated cluster (KMS, audit log forwarding destination, restricted admin access, CI/CD allowlist).

Next: I’ll open a DocuSign envelope and include the 24-month amendment + SOW. Emma, let me know if you want the standby cluster priced into the amendment or as a separate line item.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: Private footprint expansion & term ask

Kimberly / Marcus — thanks, that aligns with what we discussed internally. Crescent is comfortable with the 24-month term and the committed run-rate you proposed. A few notes:

- We will take the standby hot-swap cluster as a separate PO (probable go-live Q4) — please keep it out of the initial amendment.
- Legal will need the amendment + SOW to review; aim to send DocuSign by EOD Monday so I can escalate internally.
- We’ll provide CIDR and our VPC contact this week (Matthew is copied).
- Security: Monica — I’ll ping our InfoSec lead (cc’d) to coordinate SOC2 artifact transfer and the KMS integration checklist.

Target timeline: DocuSign signed by 2027-04-25, PO to Redwood by 2027-04-30, provisioning to start May 5 (post-PO + security sign-off). If we can accelerate the isolated cluster provisioning to a 3-week window (engineering permitting) that would really help our Q3 analytics milestones — understand if that requires an expedited provisioning fee.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Emma
Head of ML Platform | Crescent Labs
emma.zhao@crescentlabs.com
